peer_identity.arc_label: Othon's faithful servant, father of the unnamed daughter pair, later suicide victim
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Male faithful servant/household associate of Othon and father of two unnamed daughters (Nan-Nan/Ohouya as called on p08). Preserve the daughters' paired attack as related non-peer lore evidence, not as a separate Honcho peer. Iku-Tta speaks in ominous metaphors, reports his daughters' tower attack, later commits suicide, and Othon uses that death to ban tribe members and replace household service with robots.
peer_identity.rationale: Source correction from page images: vol.04 page 05 names the green servant as Iku-Tta and says 'my daughters'; vol.04 page 13 says Iku-Tta committed suicide and refers to his presence as the threat. Prior iko-itta/ik-uta records were OCR/extraction variants of Iku-Tta, not separate daughter/elder peers.
